Container.Name: NextDash
Container.DonateText: Find NextDash useful? Consider supporting the project.
Container.Overview:
NextDash is a lightweight, self-hosted bookmark dashboard that features a minimalist, keyboard-driven interface with extensive customization options, making it the perfect personal dashboard for power users. Based on the excellent ThinkDashboard.
Key features: • Keyboard-driven navigation for fast access to all your bookmarks • Extensive theme and layout customization, with a look studio beside the dashboard and a theme editor • Inbox to collect new links fast: triage them, or keep them under Bookmarks → Unsorted and file whole groups later • Bookmarks view with Health built in: finds broken, stale and duplicate links, with uptime monitoring and downtime alerts • Video bookmarks marked in the list, and played in the hover card without leaving the dashboard • Widgets beside your bookmarks: 28 built-in kinds (uptime, feeds, weather, calendar, disks, containers and more) plus a Custom widget for any JSON API • Your Unraid server on the dashboard: seven widgets for the array, parity, shares, VMs, the UPS and notifications, with alerts • Web search in the search panel through your own SearXNG or the Brave Search API • Six interface languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Chinese • Lightweight and fast, no heavy dependencies • Actively maintained with regular releases
Links: • Website: https://www.nextdash.cc • Source code and releases: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash • Changelog: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/releases • Devlog / release updates: https://www.nextdash.cc/news • Also available on GHCR: ghcr.io/jordibrouwer/nextdash:latest • User manual: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/blob/main/MANUAL.md
The host widgets (Processor, Memory, Disks, Containers) are off until you fill in the optional paths and variables below — they are hidden under Show more settings. Section 11.4 of the manual explains what each one reads.
Support: open an issue on GitHub via the Support link above. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome.
Container.Changes:
### v1.18.4.1 (2026-10-09) - Bookmarks: Shift+H opens the whole list, the same as the Bookmarks button, and also works with health checks off - Speed: Bookmarks starts loading when you point at its button, draws its list once, and no longer loads what only Appearance and the widget editor need - Views: Config, Bookmarks, Inbox and Containers open with a shorter fade
### v1.18.4 (2026-10-09) - Action bar: five ways for the buttons to come into view (swell, from the middle, together, unfold, accordion), each shown on its own card under Config → Appearance → Action bar - Speed: the theme stylesheet is cached by the browser, a view's scripts download side by side, and a long dashboard no longer stalls while it draws - Icons: icon-set icons that showed a letter show the app icon again, and Inbox links whose icon went missing fetch it again
### v1.18.3 (2026-10-09) - Action bar: the buttons can swell into view each time the bar appears (Config → Appearance → Action bar, off by default) - Dashboard: moving a block to another page is safe against a page switch and a double press; Undo after a background reload says so instead of undoing another device's change - Bookmarks: merging or deleting a category in Structure, and bulk moves to another page, act on the right items when the list refreshes meanwhile - Data: a page that briefly cannot be read is no longer cached as empty, and icons are kept while the inbox cannot be read - Reverse proxies: every X-Forwarded-For line is read, so a proxy that adds its own line no longer lets a visitor pick their rate-limit bucket - Inbox: always on now, its switch is gone; bulk Keep runs once on a double click, and promote says which links could not leave the Inbox - Bookmarks view: Show in list (was Show in Health) and the health widgets' Open in Bookmarks open it fully styled; Structure and Behavior sit above Inbox in Config
### v1.17.5 (2026-10-06) - First start: a new install asks what you run: Homelab, Media server or Developer on one server address, or keep the starter links - Config: a Version panel on the overview says whether you run the newest release; a failed update check says why, and the Containers GitHub token now counts for it - Widgets: move a widget to another page from its settings; a removed Notes widget no longer comes back after a restart - Inbox: no more limit of 500 links, so nothing is pushed out to make room - Settings: a setting you change while the dashboard refreshes stays changed - Fixes: the pages panel keeps the cursor on your page when reopened, a tablet shows the time once, and Unsorted is called Unsorted
### v1.17.4 (2026-10-05) - Privacy: a one-time card explains the daily install count and how to turn it off; on Unraid the count also says Unraid

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the NextDash web interface

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage path for NextDash data (bookmarks, settings)

Config.Name: Write token
Config.Description: Optional. Require this token in the X-NextDash-Token header on every write. Leave empty for an open instance on a trusted network.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses and CIDR ranges whose X-Forwarded-For header is believed, comma-separated — set this if nextDash sits behind a reverse proxy, so rate limits count per visitor instead of per proxy. Left empty the header is ignored.

Config.Name: Host proc
Config.Description: Optional. Mount the host /proc here for the Processor and Memory widgets. Host path: /proc

Config.Name: Host proc variable
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /host/proc once the mount above is filled in.

Config.Name: Host disks
Config.Description: Optional. Mount the array here for the Disks widget. Host path: /mnt — then name /mnt/user or /mnt/cache in the widget.

Config.Name: Host root variable
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /host/root once the disks mount above is filled in.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Mount the Docker socket here for the Containers widget. Host path: /var/run/docker.sock — read-only still exposes the daemon's whole read API, so use a socket proxy if that is too much.

Config.Name: Docker socket variable
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /var/run/docker.sock once the socket mount above is filled in. Unset, the Containers widget is hidden.

Config.Name: Docker actions
Config.Description: Optional. 1 lets the Containers view start, stop, update and remove containers; 0 keeps it read-only. A writable socket is root on the host, so set a write token as well.

Config.Name: Run as root
Config.Description: Optional. 1 keeps nextDash running as root, needed only when the Docker socket belongs to root's group (gid 0). Unraid's socket belongs to the docker group (gid 281), so leave this at 0 here.
